name: mp-host-join-cross
title: Independent host and client captures joined by the live session and round

checklist.what: The host uses the real landing screen; both full names remain readable in the lobby.
checklist.assert: Recorded menu assertions and both-peer admission/ready state.

checklist.what: The host uses the real lobby screen; both full names remain readable in the lobby.
checklist.assert: Recorded menu assertions and both-peer admission/ready state.

checklist.what: The host plays at least 600 simulation updates in the same running round.
checklist.assert: Running before and after the play leg with at least 600 updates.

checklist.what: The running match supplies its actual session, round and adopted configuration identity for merging the two videos.
checklist.assert: Nonzero native session and round; matching config hash and complementary peers in the merged contract.

checklist.what: The client uses the real landing screen; both full names remain readable in the lobby.
checklist.assert: Recorded menu assertions and both-peer admission/ready state.

checklist.what: The running match supplies its actual session, round and adopted configuration identity for merging the two videos.
checklist.assert: Nonzero native session and round; matching config hash and complementary peers in the merged contract.

checklist.what: The client dials HOST_ADDRESS:PORT through the address and port fields.
